newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian bonds, futures end soft after choppy day.
newsitem.headline: Italian bonds, futures end soft after choppy day.

text.p: 1525 GMT - Italian debt markets ending just a step inside negative territory after a choppy day of middling volumes. Dealers say Btps also unable to keep up pace of gains set in last few days.
* Bonds:Feb07 -16bps at 103.46, yield at 6.35 pct, spread vs 10-yr Bund 82 bps.
* Lira:973.80/4.10 per mark, slightly weaker than Wednesday.
